title: Sure Petcare Flap Event Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surepetcare:flap
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by pet_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Sure Petcare flap event data has stopped arriving for a given pet.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per pet and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It catches when one part of your Sure Petcare flap event feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
